**Basic App Description:**  
This app opens with a camera that, like a QR scanner, constantly looks for a CWD water meter. When it detects one, it will either auto-snap the reading or ask you to take the picture. The app will then ask for your previous reading, which you can find on your last water bill (though this step is skippable for first-time users). Using this information, it automatically calculates your estimated current bill, providing a helpful reference for budgeting to avoid bill shock.

**Settings:**  
*Frequently Changing:* Previous Reading \- asked after the capture. Categorized as frequently changing for repeatedly being asked after a capture.

*Manually Changed:* 1-10 Usage Tariff (e.g Minimum Rate) \- Fixed Value of 238.60 (that’s for the entire first 10 usage.) So if your usage is 1, 3, 6, 8 or 10 you get this minimum rate of 238.60. Now for the 11-20 Usage Tariff \- this has a fixed value of 26.20 per usage meaning if i have 12 (meaning i have to multiply 26.20 by 2\) I’ll get 52.4 then add the fixed rate of 238.60 because we’re at 12 meaning we exceeded 10, if I have 13, I have to multiply by 3 and so on. We’ll do this until we reach a Rate of 21-30 which default is 29.00. Then 31-40 that has Default 32.60. As for 41+ it’s Default 37.00.

Then for ESF it is default of 3.50.

**Calculation:**  
Take for example we have **Usage of 29** (from the reading of 1575 in the present and 1546 in previous reading (subtract them and we get 29)).

Take the first **10 usage** because remember, the first 10 is fixed **238.60 pesos.**

Now we only have **19 usages** left to calculate.

Take the second tens (11-20), because we have a complete ten usage for the second set we multiply it by 26.20 (for the 11-20 Tariff). **26.20x10 \= 262.00 pesos.**

Now take the last set of usage. Which is (21-30 that has a rate of 29.00 per usage) but because we only have 29 total usages we only have to get 9\. So **9x29.00 \= 261.00 pesos**

Add the three **238.60 \+ 262 \+ 261 \= 761.6**

**![][image1]**  
It’s accurate to what we have in the receipt. Which is **761.60**.

Now let’s calculate the ESF so we can get the total amount.

**Formula for ESF:** Total Usage x 3.50

So **29 x 3.50 \= 101.5,** also accurate to our receipt.
